verdict.rationale: Hydration strategy is a fair question for a UI framework with SSR, so the axis applies. The evidence documents server rendering (pages are server-rendered for a fast first visit) and mixing rendering types per page, but nothing describes progressive, partial or incremental hydration. Those SSR and per-page rendering features are adjacent capabilities, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can hydrate my server-rendered app progressively so pages become interactive faster
